label: GigaVUE-TA25 48x25G + 8x100G traffic aggregator
description: 1RU tap/aggregation node that funnels TAP and SPAN feeds into one any-to-any port map: 48 SFP28 cages taking 1G, 10G or 25G optics plus 8 QSFP28 cages taking 40G or 100G. GigaVUE-OS does aggregation, replication and L2-L4 flow mapping, but it is an out-of-band box with no inline forwarding path.

label: GigaVUE-HC3 modular visibility node (2x PRT-HC3-X24 + 2x PRT-HC3-C16)
description: 3RU chassis with four hot-swappable port-module bays, modelled here as two PRT-HC3-X24 modules (48 25G/10G SFP28 cages) and two PRT-HC3-C16 modules (32 40G/100G QSFP28 cages). Bypass modules can sit inline in front of IPS/WAF tools, so the same node serves out-of-band aggregation and inline fail-to-wire protection.

label: Vision 7712 32x100G packet broker
description: 1RU high-density packet broker built on the Edgecore 7712 platform and running Vision Edge OS: 32 QSFP28 cages that run 100G, 40G, 4x25G or 4x10G each. Used as the spine of a visibility fabric, aggregating many TAP/SPAN feeds and filtering them toward tool farms.

label: Vision Edge 40 (E40) 48x10G + 6x40G packet broker
description: Ixia-lineage 1RU packet broker with 48 SFP/SFP+ ports at 1G or 10G and 6 QSFP+ ports at 40G, each 40G cage able to break out to four more 1G/10G links (72 ports total). Filters, aggregates and load-balances rack-level SPAN/TAP traffic toward monitoring and security tools.

label: AA10G54AC 48x10G + 6x40G packet broker
description: Fixed-port 1RU packet broker for top-of-rack and edge use: 48 SFP/SFP+ cages at 1G or 10G plus 6 QSFP+ cages at 40G that can each take 4x10G. Aggregates, filters (L2-L4) and load-balances TAP/SPAN inputs onto tools, with GRE/VXLAN tunnel origination for remote feeds.

label: Cubro EXA8 8x1G + 2x10G session master / aggregator
description: Compact fanless aggregation and capture box: 8 native RJ45 ports at 10/100/1000 plus 2 SFP/SFP+ cages at 1G or 10G, usable as 4 copper TAPs feeding 2 x 10G outputs in either direction. Runs L4/L7 filtering, de-duplication and keyword/regex search, and can stream filtered traffic straight to a pcap on its SSD.

label: Arista 7050SX3-48YC8 running DANZ Monitoring Fabric
description: Merchant-silicon 1RU switch repurposed as a DANZ Monitoring Fabric (DMF) leaf: 48 SFP28 cages at 1/10/25G plus 8 QSFP28 cages at 40/100G, all software-controlled by a DMF controller. The fabric does filtering, replication and load-balancing for the tool farm instead of a fixed box-by-box NPB.

label: OM3501 passive 10G-SR multimode fibre TAP (1 tap, 50/50, LC)
description: Passive 1-tap optical splitter for a duplex OM3 multimode link at 100M/1G/10G: the two network LC ports pass traffic through unpowered and each direction is split 50/50 onto its own monitor LC port. No power, no IP stack, no management - it is a pure optical coupler, so a dead tap cannot drop the live link.

label: P1GCCB passive 10/100/1000 copper breakout TAP
description: Passive inline breakout tap for a 10/100/1000BASE-T copper link: two RJ45 network ports stay mated to the live link and two RJ45 monitor ports hand a full-duplex copy to the tool. Unpowered and failsafe, with no IP stack - PoE passes through to the powered device.

label: OM4501 40G-SR4 BiDi passive multimode fibre TAP (1 tap, 50/50, MTP)
description: Passive 40G tap for OM4 multimode: two MTP/MPO network ports carry the bidirectional 40GBASE-SR4 link through unpowered and two MTP/MPO monitor ports deliver the 50/50 copies. Pure optical split, no power and no management interface.
